questions.question: x and y are in direct proportion and y = 92.5 when x = 37. What will be the value of y when x = 16?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Since **x** and **y** are in **direct proportion**, the ratio **y/x** is constant.

Constant ratio (k) = 92.5 ÷ 37 = 2.5

Required value of y = 16 × 2.5 = 40

**∴ The correct answer is 40.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** x₁ = 37, y₁ = 92.5 and x₂ = 16

**Formula:** For **direct proportion**, y₁/x₁ = y₂/x₂

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c7052b6d3b81c1bcb17a4d5ad34beee1ae37bdf94c7c905d1243c02babdc7273.png] 

⇒ 92.5 / 37 = y / 16

⇒ 2.5 = y / 16

⇒ y = 2.5 × 16

⇒ y = 40

**∴ The correct answer is 40.**

**__Additional Information__**

Direct Proportion

Two quantities x and y are in **direct proportion** if the ratio x/y remains constant (k). The relation is expressed as y = kx.

Inverse Proportion

Two quantities x and y are in **inverse proportion** if their product xy remains constant (k). The relation is expressed as y = k/x.

Constant of Proportionality

The value **k** is the **constant of proportionality**, which defines the rate of change between the two related variables.</p

questions.question: A person invested some amount at the rate of 12% per annum simple interest and another amount at the rate of 10% per annum simple interest. He received yearly interest of ₹125 from both the investments. But if he had interchanged the amounts invested, he would have received ₹3 more as interest. How much did he invest at 10% per annum simple interest originally?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Rate of interest for Scheme A (R) = 12% per annum 

Rate of interest for Scheme B (R) = 10% per annum 

Total Simple Interest = Rs. 125

**Formula Used:**

SI = (P × R × T)/100

**Calculations:**

Let the amount invested in Scheme A be 'x' and that invested in Scheme B be 'y' Then, the total annual interest,

(y × 10 × 1)/100 + (x × 12 × 1)/100 = 125

⇒ (12x + 10y)/100 = 125

⇒ 6x + 5y = 6250 ..........(1)

Again, the amount invested in Scheme B is 12% 'y' and the invested in Scheme B is 'x'.Then, total annual interest at the new rates

(x × 10 × 1)/100 + (y × 12 × 1)/100 = 128

⇒ (10x + 12y)/100 = 128

⇒ 5x + 6y = 6400 ..........(2)

Adding (1) and (2), we get

⇒ 11x + 11y = 12650

⇒ 11(x + y) = 12650

⇒ x + y = 1150 ............(3)

Subtracting (2) from (1), we get

⇒ x - y = -150 ..............(4)

Adding (3) and (4), we get

⇒ 2x = (1150 -150)/2 = 500 

Putting x = 500 in (3), we get

⇒ 500 + y = 1150

⇒ y = Rs. 650

**∴ The amount invested at 10% per annum simple interest originally is 650.**

questions.question: The circumference of the base of a right circular cylinder is 176 cm and its height is 12 cm. Find the total surface area (in cm²) of the cylinder. (Use pi = frac{{22}}{7})
questions.solution:
**Given: ** 

Circumference of the base (C) = 176 cm 

Height (h) = 12 cm 

**Formula used: **

Circumference of the base = 2 × π × r 

Total surface area (TSA) of cylinder = 2 × π × r × (r + h) 

**Calculation: **

According to the question,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80a4c9a8ee5775950d4e143c7c6421e8822426a85ff34ed5f09abf40ebb967a7.png]

176 = 2 × π × r 

⇒ 176 = 2 × 22 / 7 × r 

⇒ 176 × 7 / 2 × 22 = r 

⇒ 8 × 7 / 2 = r 

⇒ r = 56 / 2 

⇒ r = 28 

Now T.S.A.: 

2 × π × 28 × (28 + 12) 

⇒ 2 × π × 28 × 40 

⇒ 2 × π × 1120 

⇒ 2240 × π = 7040 cm2.

** ∴ The Total Surface Area of the cylinder will be 7040 cm².**

questions.question: The radius of a cylinder is 16(2)/(3)\% more than the radius of a hemisphere. The height of the cylinder is 21 cm. Ratio of **Radius** (Cylinder : Hemisphere) = (100 + 16 2/3) : 100 = 7 : 6

Volume of **Cylinder** = Volume of **Sphere** ⇒ π × R꜀yₗ² × 21 = 4/3 × π × 7³

R꜀yₗ² = (4 × 343) ÷ (3 × 21) = 196/9 ⇒ R꜀yₗ = 14/3 cm

Since 7 units = 14/3, then 6 units (Rₕₑₘ) = (14/3 ÷ 7) × 6 = 4 cm

Volume of **Hemisphere** = 2/3 × 22/7 × 4³ = 2816/21 ≈ 134.10 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 134.10 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ **Height of cylinder** (H) = 21 cm

⇒ **Radius of sphere** (Rₛ) = 7 cm

⇒ R꜀yₗ = Rₕₑₘ × (1 + 16 2/3%) = Rₕₑₘ × (1 + 1/6) = 7/6 × Rₕₑₘ

**Formula Used:**

⇒ **Volume of Cylinder** = πR²H

⇒ **Volume of Sphere** = 4/3 πR³

⇒ **Volume of Hemisphere** = 2/3 πR³

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume of Cylinder = Volume of Sphere

⇒ π × R꜀yₗ² × 21 = 4/3 × π × 7³

⇒ R꜀yₗ² × 21 = 4/3 × 343

⇒ R꜀yₗ² = (4 × 343) ÷ (3 × 21) = 1372 ÷ 63 = 196/9

⇒ R꜀yₗ = √(196/9) = 14/3 cm

⇒ Rₕₑₘ = 6/7 × R꜀yₗ = 6/7 × 14/3 = 4 cm

⇒ Volume of Hemisphere = 2/3 × 22/7 × 4³

⇒ Volume of Hemisphere = (2 × 22 × 64) ÷ (3 × 7) = 2816 ÷ 21 ≈ 134.0952 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 134.10 cm³.**

questions.question: If it was Monday on 12th August in a particular year, then what will be the day on 26th September of the same year?
questions.solution:
Given that:-

No of days from 12th August to 26th September = (31 -12) + 26 = 19 + 26 = **45** days. 

Since, it was **Monday **on 12th August, every 7th day from 12th August will be a Monday.

Thus, no. of odd days = 45/7 = 3.

Now, 12th August (Monday) + 3 odd days = 26th September (Thursday).

26th September will be **Thursday**.

Hence, **"option 3" **is the correct answer.

• A pupa forms following the completion of larval development and contains the metamorphosing adult.
 
• During the stage, the caterpillar forms a** protective chrysalis** that protects it from the outside world while allowing it to undergo important changes. 

 The caterpillar will stay in this stage for about **a week. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Each of the four stages is very unique to individual species of butterflies which is part of what makes watching and raising butterflies so much fun.
 
• The adult butterfly **first lays her eggs** safely on a leaf. Depending on the type of butterfly, she may lay just one egg, dozens of eggs, or up to hundreds of eggs at once.
 
• The egg begins to hatch and a caterpillar is revealed. This caterpillar is known as the **larva stag**e. The caterpillar crawls out of the egg and immediately begins to start eating.
 
• After about a week later, the caterpillar is ready to emerge from its chrysalis and enter the** fourth stage** of the life cycle.

questions.question: Find the greatest possible number which on dividing 2307 and 3105 leaves remainders of 7 and 5 respectively.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The required greatest number is the HCF of the numbers obtained after subtracting the respective remainders.

Required Number = HCF of (2307 − 7) and (3105 − 5)

Required Number = HCF of 2300 and 3100

Both 2300 and 3100 are directly divisible by 100, and 23 and 31 are co-prime.

**∴ The correct answer is 100.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Dividend numbers = 2307 and 3105

Respective remainders = 7 and 5

**Formula Used:**

The greatest number that divides x and y leaving remainders a and b respectively is given by the Highest Common Factor (HCF) of (x − a) and (y − b).

**Calculations:**

⇒ First resulting number = 2307 − 7 = 2300

⇒ Second resulting number = 3105 − 5 = 3100

⇒ Now, find the prime factorization of 2300 and 3100:

⇒ 2300 = 23 × 100 = 23 × 2² × 5²

⇒ 3100 = 31 × 100 = 31 × 2² × 5²

⇒ The common factors between the two prime factorizations are 2² and 5².

⇒ HCF = 2² × 5²

⇒ HCF = 4 × 25 = 100

**∴ The correct answer is 100.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Greatest Number Dividing with Specific Remainders

The greatest number that will divide x, y, and z leaving individual remainders a, b, and c respectively is given by finding the HCF of (x − a), (y − b), and (z − c).

Greatest Number Dividing with Same Remainder

The greatest number that will divide x, y, and z leaving the exact same remainder 'r' in each case is given by finding the HCF of (x − r), (y − r), and (z − r).

Greatest Number Dividing with Unknown Same Remainder

When x, y, and z are divided by the greatest number leaving the same but unknown remainder, the required number is the HCF of the absolute differences: |x − y|, |y − z|, and |z − x|.

Product Rule of LCM and HCF

For any two numbers 'A' and 'B', the product of the given numbers is strictly equal to the product of their LCM and HCF. Rule: A × B = LCM(A, B) × HCF(A, B).

questions.question: Pipes A and B can fill an empty tank completely in 42 minutes and 56 minutes respectively. Pipe C alone can empty the full tank in 84 minutes. All the three pipes are opened together for 8 minutes and then C is closed. In how much time (in minutes) will A and B together fill the remaining part of the tank?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken to fill a tank by Pipe A = 42 min

Time taken to fill a tank by Pipe B = 56 min

Time taken to empty a full tank by Pipe C = 84 min

**Formula used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time 

**Calculation:**

LCM of 42, 56, and 84 is 168

⇒ Efficiency of A = 168/42 = 4 units/min

⇒ Efficiency of B = 168/56 = 3 units/min

⇒ Efficiency of C = 168/84 = 2 units/min

⇒ Efficiency of B and A together = 4 + 3 = 7 units/min

⇒ A, B and C opened for 8 min = (7 - 2) × 8 = 40 units

Now, Pipes A and B will fill the remaining empty tank = 168 - 40 = 128

⇒ Time = 128/7 = ​​18(2)/(7) mins

**∴ Time taken by Pipes A and B to fill the remaining tank will be 128 / 7 mins or 18(2)/(7) mins.**

questions.question:
Calculate the value of frac{{Range}}{{Median}} for the set of data given below:

134, 98, 194, 122, 108, 156
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Arrange **data** in ascending order: 98, 108, 122, 134, 156, 194.

**Range** = Maximum − Minimum = 194 − 98 = 96.

**Median** (n=6) = Average of 3rd and 4th terms = (122 + 134) ÷ 2 = 128.

Required **Value** = Range ÷ Median = 96 ÷ 128 = 3/4.

**∴ The correct answer is 3/4.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given data:** 134, 98, 194, 122, 108, 156

**Step 1:** Sort the data set: 98, 108, 122, 134, 156, 194.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21b55df67db8f5b0ccb322f3f9e55795db964d2613acb4e2fee9f94c0268d440.png] 

**Step 2: Calculate Range**

⇒ **Range** = Largest value − Smallest value

⇒ **Range** = 194 − 98 = 96

**Step 3: Calculate Median**

⇒ Number of observations (n) = 6 (even)

⇒ **Median** = [(n/2)th term + (n/2 + 1)th term] ÷ 2

⇒ **Median** = [3rd term + 4th term] ÷ 2

⇒ **Median** = (122 + 134) ÷ 2 = 256 ÷ 2 = 128

**Step 4: Calculate Range ÷ Median**

⇒ Ratio = 96 ÷ 128

⇒ Ratio = (32 × 3) ÷ (32 × 4)

⇒ Ratio = 3/4

**∴ The correct answer is 3/4.**

**__Additional Information__**

Median for Even and Odd Data

For odd n, Median = ((n+1)/2)th term. For even n, Median = average of (n/2)th and (n/2+1)th terms.

Range in Statistics

The **Range** is the simplest measure of dispersion and is calculated as the difference between the **Maximum** and **Minimum** observations.

Coefficient of Range

Coefficient of Range = (Max − Min) ÷ (Max + Min). It is a relative measure of dispersion.</p

questions.question: Two students appeared for an entrance examination. One of them secured 15 marks more than the other and his marks are 80% of the sum of their marks. What are the marks obtained by each of them?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Among two students one of them secured 15 marks more than the other and his marks were 80% of the sum of their marks.

**Concept Used:**

Concept of the linear equation of one variable.

**Calculation:**

Let, one of them scored x

Then the score of the other student is (x + 15)

Sum of their marks = (x + x + 15) = (2x + 15)

Accordingly,

(x + 15) = (80/100) × (2x + 15)

⇒ 5 × (x + 15) = 4 × (2x + 15)

⇒ 5x + 75 = 8x + 60

⇒ (8x - 5x) = (75 - 60)

⇒ 3x = 15

⇒ x = 5

The number secured by the other student,

⇒ 5 + 15 = 20

**∴ The marks obtained by them are 5 and 20.**
